chunks.text:
# POL-AUTO-001 Comprehensive Auto Coverage

Policy type: comprehensive auto
Effective: 2026-01-01

chunks.heading: Covered perils
chunks.text:
Comprehensive coverage pays for damage to the insured vehicle from non-collision events,
including theft, vandalism, fire, hail, and falling objects.

chunks.heading: Rental reimbursement
chunks.text:
If the insured vehicle is stolen or declared a total loss, the policy reimburses rental
car expenses up to USD 40 per day for 30 days when the driver reports theft within
24 hours and cooperates with law enforcement.

chunks.heading: Out-of-state use
chunks.text:
Vehicles garaged in the home state remain covered while temporarily used in other US
states for up to 90 consecutive days. Permanent relocation requires notifying the
carrier within 10 days.

chunks.heading: Deductible
chunks.text: Comprehensive claims are subject to a USD 500 deductible unless a waiver rider applies.

chunks.heading: intro
chunks.text:
# POL-AUTO-001 Exclusions and Limits

Policy type: comprehensive auto
Related policy: POL-AUTO-001

chunks.heading: General exclusions
chunks.text:
The policy does not cover intentional damage, racing, or commercial ride-share use
without a commercial rider.

chunks.heading: Rental car limits
chunks.text:
Rental reimbursement does not apply when the vehicle is available for repair within
72 hours, or when the driver lives outside the rated garaging state without an
out-of-state rider on file.

chunks.heading: Theft reporting
chunks.text:
Theft claims require a police report number. Delay beyond 24 hours may reduce rental
reimbursement to 15 days.

chunks.heading: intro
chunks.text:
# POL-HEALTH-020 Emergency Services

Policy type: group health
Related policy: POL-HEALTH-020

chunks.heading: Emergency definition
chunks.text:
Emergency services are covered when a prudent layperson would believe delay would
seriously jeopardize health, including severe chest pain and major trauma.

chunks.heading: Post-stabilization
chunks.text:
After stabilization, non-emergency services at out-of-network facilities may require
transfer or prior auth for continued inpatient days beyond 48 hours.

chunks.heading: intro
chunks.text:
# POL-HEALTH-020 Prior Authorization

Policy type: group health
Effective: 2026-01-01

chunks.heading: Imaging services
chunks.text:
MRI and CT scans require prior authorization when ordered outside an emergency visit.
Emergency imaging is covered without prior auth when documented within 48 hours.

chunks.heading: Specialty referrals
chunks.text:
Specialist visits require PCP referral except for OB/GYN and behavioral health per
state mandate addendum POL-HEALTH-020-BH.

chunks.heading: Turnaround
chunks.text: Standard prior auth decisions publish within 72 hours; urgent requests within 24 hours.

chunks.heading: intro
chunks.text:
# POL-HOME-FLOOD Flood Rider

Policy type: homeowners rider
Parent policy: POL-HOME-010

chunks.heading: Scope
chunks.text:
Covers flood as defined by FEMA, including storm surge, when the rider is active and
the property is in an enrolled flood zone.

chunks.heading: Not covered
chunks.text:
Sewer backup without simultaneous flood event remains excluded unless POL-HOME-SEWER
rider is attached.

chunks.heading: intro
chunks.text:
# POL-HOME-010 Water Damage Coverage

Policy type: homeowners
Effective: 2026-01-01

chunks.heading: Burst pipe coverage
chunks.text:
Sudden and accidental discharge from plumbing systems, including burst pipes, is
covered up to USD 10,000 after the USD 1,000 deductible.

chunks.heading: Gradual seepage exclusion
chunks.text:
Gradual seepage, maintenance neglect, and flood (defined separately) are excluded.
Flood coverage requires POL-HOME-FLOOD rider.

chunks.heading: Documentation
chunks.text: Claims must include photos, plumber invoice, and date-of-loss within 14 days.
